name: mcp.airsidelabs.com
description:
Accurate aviation answers for AI agents, with the source behind every one.
Identity: resolve airports, airlines, aircraft types, registrations and flight designators to canonical entities from validated registry data, with confidence, temporal validity and per-field provenance. Pass a date for historical questions, because codes are reused, and cross-check a set of identifiers against each other with validate_identifiers.
Airport facts from published documents: an airport's level of integration with the EUROCONTROL Network Manager or the FAA's TFDM programme as of a date, who operates and owns it, whether it is open for ordinary engagement, its nonstop destinations by country, and its ACI passenger size band, each with the source and the date it was read.
AI use cases: a catalogue of more than 6,500 aviation AI use cases for airlines, airports, ANSPs, MROs and regulators, each with its data requirements and update cadence and, where assessed, a screen against EASA's AI-level and hazard framework, page-cited.
Four tools work with no account at all. Sign in for the rest on the free Explorer plan; paid plans lift the monthly allowance. Every tool is read-only except two that file feedback for a person to read. Reference and research data, not real-time or operational information: verify with official sources before acting.

_published_faq.name: How do I add mcp.airsidelabs.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add mcp.airsidelabs.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.airsidelabs.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the mcp.airsidelabs.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: mcp.airsidelabs.com lists 21 MCP tools, including airport_connectivity, airport_network_integration, airport_operations_status, airport_operator, airport_size_band, data_requirements, easa_ai_framework, feedback_status, get_use_case, parse_flight_identifier, report_unmet_need, and resolve_aircraft_type.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to mcp.airsidelabs.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to mcp.airsidelabs.com in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
mcp.airsidelabs.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
mcp.airsidelabs.com is developed by Airside Labs. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
